speaker: richard_field
text: Thou art down again. The sleeve is wet, and I am not ashamed of it. Drink. The cup was poured before the laugh, and it is still a cup.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: Sit if you are sitting. I am not asking you anything. I have had the answer I came down for, and I am not spending a second one on a man who has already said good night.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then I will drink, and I will not stand up to make the good night true before the leaf is shut. It is open. I am not writing on it.
